character_description: Young adult female in her late 20s, deep and composed voice, authoritative yet feminine, slow and deliberate pacing, experienced veteran quality, elegant and mysterious, subtle confidence. Studio-quality recording.
audition_line: 在这行摸爬滚打这么多年，古董和艺术品的门道我早已了然于胸。年轻人总喜欢冲动出价，殊不知真正的高手都是后发制人的。让他们先争，我只需要等一个最好的时机。
